families.description: Versioned data products and internal authority tables
Port authorities where port status is semantically load-bearing
Bibliographic works, witnesses and source authorities
Programmes, trenches, essays and delivery projects

reserved.reason: Programme root; never assign to a child project or content record

procedures.rename: Keep the canonical ID; change only the display label or slug alias.
procedures.merge: Choose one surviving ID and reserve every merged ID as an alias pointing to it.
procedures.split: Retain the old ID as a deprecated aggregate and mint new IDs for the separated referents.
procedures.retire: Reserve the ID permanently and record a replacement or an explicit no-replacement reason.
procedures.redirect: Public URL changes require a permanent redirect or machine-readable migration mapping before release.

compatibility.localConvention: Existing essay slugs and map/cartographer/layer keys remain unchanged and become the localId component.
Existing unprefixed port, route, territory and source keys remain stable within the VMN authority.
Existing hse-* record IDs remain stable; place_id remains the referent join while id identifies a dated phase.
Existing plc/src/att/nmu/nue prefixes remain stable and become local IDs inside the CND authority.

tiers.definition: Editorial assertion or unverified lead; never publishable as fact
Identified source or dataset without a feature-level locator
Source plus page, folio, sheet, feature or equivalent stable locator
Directly inspectable primary witness with stable locator and rights state
Two or more independent primary witnesses, or primary evidence corroborated by critical scholarship

roles.historicalVerification: Confirms claims against identified evidence and locators
roles.dataAcceptance: Accepts schema, vocabulary, provenance and integrity results
roles.rightsClearance: Records the applicable licence or restriction and publication conditions
roles.releaseApproval: Confirms all applicable gates before publication

citiesRemember.exception: Cities Remember carries two scholarly plates as its argument - the 1920x1185 Nolli sheet at 1,209,518 bytes and the Nuremberg chronicle view at 472,412 - and every reader who scrolls the essay downloads both. Until the full-width editorial layout (#127) they sat far enough down a 707px column to fall outside Chrome's lazy-load horizon during a Lighthouse run, so the content budget was measuring the fold rather than the page: 492 KiB reported against 2.13 MiB actually served. The wider column shortens the page by ~2,800px and brings them inside it, and the audit now reports 2,174,726 bytes for the same page. The ceiling is set above that number rather than below it because neither cheaper option survives measurement: re-encoding takes the sheet from 1181 to 829 KiB (mozjpeg q82; webp is worse at 984) and the chronicle from 461 to 442, still over the content budget and at the cost of the engraved detail CityMemoryOverlay invites readers to inspect, and the sheet cannot be resized because geo:interop:validate asserts its 1920x1185 frame for four overlay control points and the published annotation manifest pins the same dimensions. Every other content route keeps the 1,250,000 ceiling. A cheaper treatment of the plates themselves is content work, tracked separately.

atlas.exception: MapLibre is an intentional above-fold WebGL dependency. Its aggregate performance score and its total blocking time are both dominated by that widget and swing by more than 2x with the machine: 2844ms and 2896ms measured on main and 2605ms on the KAN-405-414 branch on one development host, against 1238ms for that same branch on a GitHub runner, while the shipped JS differed by 1.8 KiB. A hard TBT threshold measures the runner rather than the diff, so both are monitored warnings (KAN-407). Accessibility, LCP, CLS and the transfer budgets - which do track what this project controls - remain hard failures.

deepZoomFallback.initialSurface: Rights-cleared static image with alt text and attribution
deepZoomFallback.unsupportedBrowser: Keep the static image and expose the source/download link
deepZoomFallback.networkOrTileFailure: Restore or retain the static image; never leave an empty viewer
deepZoomFallback.lowResource: Do not initialise until the reader requests zoom; reading and citation remain available without it
